fact: The fourth meeting of the TSMP II Steering Committee, chaired by the Permanent Secretary of the Ministry of Finance, met on 15 July 2026 and reviewed implementation for 2025/26, putting the project at 88.9 percent complete with its end in June 2027, and approved the 2026/27 work plan and budget.
title: Kamati ya Uongozi MoF Yapitia Utekelezaji Mradi wa TSMP II, Kupitisha Bajeti Mwaka wa Fedha 2026/2027
